title: coscene level
description: One level. The engine reads initialState and validationRules according to archetypeId; see docs/level-schema.md for the shape each archetype expects.

id.description: Unique across all packs. Bundled levels use pNN-lNN.

place.description: Topic number, 1 to 30 in the bundled pack (1-10 easy, 11-20 medium, 21-30 hard). 0 is reserved for daily scenes.

index.description: Position inside the topic, starting at 1.

i18nKey.description: Dictionary key of the question, scene.<topic>.<variant>. '<i18nKey>.objective' must exist.

conceptId.description: The topic, which names the idea on the reveal sheet. 'concept.<conceptId>.name', '.idea' and '.seen' and 'reveal.<conceptId>' must exist.

textParams.description: Values substituted into {placeholders} in the objective.

hints.description: Dictionary keys of the progressive hints, mildest first.

initialState.description: What the player sees and changes: the board and fields (answer), the range and check budget (probe), the tiles (pick), the items and mode (ops), or the grid (route).

validationRules.description: The win condition: expected answers (answer), the rule and its target or best value (pick), the best path cost (route).
